name: Shakespeare's Stratford
blurb: Over Clopton Bridge, past the theatre and Holy Trinity, out to Anne Hathaway's Cottage at Shottery and back.

name: Shottery to Wilmcote
blurb: From Anne Hathaway's Cottage to Mary Arden's farm at Wilmcote, on to Aston Cantlow and back by Billesley.

name: Down the Avon
blurb: Along the river through Luddington and Welford-on-Avon to Bidford, over its medieval bridge and home by Barton and Weston-on-Avon.

name: Two aqueducts
blurb: Under the Edstone Aqueduct, England's longest, and past the Wootton Wawen aqueduct, back over the hills by Bearley and Snitterfield.

name: Alcester and the Alne valley
blurb: North from Alcester through Coughton Fields to Great and Little Alne and Aston Cantlow, back over the hill at Haselor.

name: Charlecote and Hampton Lucy
blurb: Out along the Avon to Charlecote Park, over the river at Hampton Lucy and home by Alveston.

name: Snitterfield hills
blurb: The hilliest lanes on the map: up to Snitterfield, over to Bearley, on to Norton Lindsey, Wolverton and Langley, and back down through Snitterfield.

name: Bidford Bridge and the flats
blurb: Over Bidford's medieval bridge to the flat lanes south of the river: Marlcliff, Bickmarsh, Dorsington and Long Marston, back by Welford.

name: The Stour villages
blurb: South along the Stour: Clifford Chambers, Atherstone, Preston-on-Stour and Alderminster.

name: Grand tour
blurb: A big loop: Wilmcote, the Edstone Aqueduct, Wootton Wawen, Great Alne and Alcester, home over Haselor and Billesley.

name: Avon sprint
blurb: Short, flat and fast: along the Avon to Tiddington and Alveston and back.

name: Welcombe and Ingon hills
blurb: The best climbing on the map: up the Warwick Road and Ingon Lane, over Hatton Rock, round by Langley and back down through Snitterfield.

name: The Warwickshire 100
blurb: A long day through every corner: the Stour villages, Long Marston, Welford, Bidford, Alcester, the Alne valley, both aqueducts and Charlecote.
